title: example 306 replay (gate A4, Framework db9a10bf): spring-core 5.3.6 and 5.3.7's PatternMatchUtils.simpleMatch on the original JARs
description: The job runs python3 examples/tools/build.py 306 --task replay, the target route of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md: workflow plans the task from target.json, runtime prepares each revision by the published-artifact route (every JAR acquired from Maven Central by the sha256 its sidecar pins, refused on a mismatch; driver and adapter compiled with --release 21), runs the packet's driver over its probes in a separate JVM per revision on JDK 21 and on JDK 25, and workflow ingests the records into one format-2 receipt under receipts/replay/, reading each revision's driver lines with the packet's independent oracle (controls/oracle.py problems()). A replay decides no claim: build.py exits 0 only when the receipt's matchesExpected is true, i.e. every revision ran on both JDKs, exited 0 with structured observations, and each shows what its pair's kind expects on both JDKs alike. No proof runs. This is Phase 5 step 1's first run of a real packet through the merged infrastructure; a failure in a stream's code is a finding to fix with a reproducer. Example 306, an independent historical positive: commit db9a10bf replaced simpleMatch's prefix-substring equality with startsWith, a behaviour-preserving change. Its release pair is v5.3.6 (83c6d100) and v5.3.7 (b1280ffe), spring-core and spring-jcl (4 pinned JARs); the oracle is a statement written from the method's Javadoc, over 40 probes. The pair's kind is release on a positive case, so both releases must hold: this job is the first after ingestion stopped reading every release pair as a fix (this commit).
expected: build.py prints '306-...: task replay: none (completed; as expected)' and exits 0: release-before and release-after both hold the oracle on all probes, on JDK 21 and 25 alike; a receipt under examples/306-*/receipts/replay/

resources.notes: 4 small JARs from Maven Central, two javac runs per revision, four short JVM runs
